VIP Exclusive | BXUSD US Treasury Wealth APY Boost
BingX

To thank VIP users for their long-term support, BingX is launching an exclusive APY boost benefit for BXUSD US Treasury Wealth. In addition to the base APY of the BXUSD US Treasury product, VIP users can get an APY boost based on their VIP level. The higher the level, the higher the boost rate and the maximum eligible amount.
For details on the BXUSD US Treasury Wealth product, please refer to: https://bingx.com/support/articles/17740950186639
I. Benefit effective days

This benefit is valid long-term for natural VIP users. The APY boost benefit and interest rates may be adjusted each phase. Refer to the official announcement for the current phase for the most accurate details.
II. Benefit details
Your VIP APY = Base APY + VIP APY boost
APY Boost
Max Boost (BXUSD)
Higher levels offer an APY boost and max boost that are no lower than those of the level below.
The base APY follows the yield currently in effect for the BXUSD US Treasury product.

If you subscribed before the VIP rate boost benefit launched, you don't need to manually redeem. The system will automatically calculate and pay your boost reward based on your actual daily VIP level after the upgrade.

*Special note: BXUSD currently offers a limited-time universal subsidy of 0.90%, which is included in the base APY of the BXUSD Wealth product. The base APY shown on the current page consists of two parts: the base U.S. Treasury yield plus the platform's limited-time universal subsidy.

Going forward, changes to the base APY will mainly come from two factors: the expiration of the limited-time universal subsidy, and changes in the U.S. Treasury yield itself. Refer to the real-time rate shown on the corresponding product page for the exact figure.
III. Interest-bearing principal
The APY boost is calculated only on the BXUSD principal you hold, up to your level's max boost. Any amount exceeding this limit earns interest at the base APY.
Interest is calculated based on your actual VIP level at the time of settlement. After a level change, the benefit of the new level applies.
IV. Settlement and distribution

After a successful subscription, interest starts accruing from the next 14:00 (UTC+8). Rewards are automatically distributed to the Spot Account under your main account at around 18:00 (UTC+8) on the day after interest accrual begins, and accumulate in BXUSD.
There are two types of rewards:
Daily reward: Calculated and distributed daily using the formula [Holdings × APY ÷ 365]

Boost reward: This benefit applies only to users at natural VIP levels. Newly subscribed shares will be included in the snapshot calculation on the day after subscription, and interest payments will start from the day after the calculation is completed.
The VIP APY boost rewards are distributed to the Spot Account. The base APY follows the original US Treasury product rules and is not affected.
V. How to participate
Method One: Through the VIP page
Open the app, go to the VIP personal page, check the Exclusive US Treasury Offer, and confirm your VIP APY.
After you complete the subscription, the system automatically applies your VIP APY boost.
Method Two: Direct subscription
Go directly to the US Treasury Wealth page to complete your subscription. The APY boost for natural VIP users takes effect automatically:

App: Home > Wealth > BXUSD > Subscribe to BXUSD *To subscribe to BXUSD in the app, first update the app to version 5.7.0 or later (expected to be released after 11-25). If you haven't updated yet, you can subscribe directly on the web instead.
Web: BingX homepage > Wealth in the top navigation bar > BXUSD > Subscribe to BXUSD: https://bingx.com/wealth/bxusd
VI. Rules and notes
This benefit is based on your natural VIP level. Trial pass users are not eligible for this benefit.
This benefit is recalculated daily based on user's latest VIP level.
The benefit's effective date and termination date are based on the UTC+8 natural day. Once the benefit is delisted, it no longer applies to new subscriptions.
⚠️ Risk warning

APY is a floating rate that may be adjusted based on market conditions. Historical yields do not represent future returns. BXUSD is not a stablecoin, security, fund, or on-chain asset, and does not represent ownership of any real-world asset. Read the BXUSD Product Terms of Service carefully before applying.

In accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and compliance requirements, BXUSD Wealth products are currently unavailable to users in the following countries and regions. Affected users will not be able to participate in subscriptions, holdings, or related services:
Region
Country / Region (including but not limited to)

Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, North Korea, Iran
